newsitem.title: UK: UK seeks further comments on Porterbrook takeover.
newsitem.headline: UK seeks further comments on Porterbrook takeover.

text.p: UK on Monday invited further representations to the Director General of Fair Trading (DGFT) on the acquisition of Porterbrook Leasing Company Ltd by Stagecoach Holdings Plc before it was referred to the Monopolies and Mergers Commission.
Stagecoach announced a 476 million stg agreed bid for Porterbrook Leasing, one of three rolling stock leasing operators , in July, 1996.

John Taylor, the minister of corporate and consumer affairs said on Monday that the DGFT had received 20 representations from third parties and comments from the Rail regulator and the Franchising director's office.
He said Stagecoach was being asked to make available the text of the draft undertaking in a specific format.
Lang said he invited comments to the text which should be sent in to the DGFT's office by December 16.
